title: Margayi hai sakina wawaila
body:
MAR GAYI HAIN SAKINA WAWAILA
MAA KO BE AAS KAR GAYI HAI HAI, KIS QADAR ZULM SEH GAYI HAI HAI, QHAID MEIN GHUT KE REH GAYI HAI HAI, GHUP ANDHERE MEIN MAR GAYI HAI HAI
KAAN ZAKHMI HAI DASHT HAI ZAKHMI, GAAL NEELE HAI PUSHT HAI ZAKHMI, PAOUN MEIN AABELE HAIN SAR ZAKHMI, SAR SE PA TAK HAIN SAB BADAN ZAKHMI
TERA GHAM KHANA YAAD AATA HAI, TERA GHABRANA YAAD AATA HAI, RONA RULWANA YAAD AATA HAI, TERA TUTLANA YAAD AATA HAI
QHAID MEIN QABAR KHODI JAYI HAI, BHAI BEHNA KO AB UTHAYE HAI, PAOUN MEIN BEDHI ULJHI JAYE HAI, MAA YE MANZAR NA DEKH PAYE HAI
PEETO SAR FATIMA KI POTI HAI, KUNJ MARQAD MEIN AAJ SOTI HAI, MAA KI GODI SE DOOR HOTI HAI, JIS PE GHURBAT SAYEED ROTI HAI..
